fact.title: The North Star
fact.summary: Polaris, also called the North Star, appears almost fixed in the night sky and has helped travelers find their way for hundreds of years.

fact.title: Constellations
fact.summary: A constellation is a pattern of stars that people imagined as pictures, like animals, heroes, or objects in the sky.

fact.title: Stars and Colors
fact.summary: Stars can look white, but they actually come in many colors. Blue stars are usually hotter than red stars.

fact.title: Our Closest Star
fact.summary: The Sun is a star too! It looks bigger and brighter because it is much closer to Earth than the other stars.
